correctness.rationale: Identity I=n²/8+L/4−W²/8 is verified both algebraically and by exhaustive exact enumeration. Reversal symmetry gives E[I|K]=K(n−K)/2 and complement symmetry gives exact Cov(K,I)=0. Finite dependence follows from K=0 forcing I=0 while P(I>0)>0. For nh→∞, bounded martingale innovations have deterministic conditional variance and triangular array Lindeberg; coefficient approximation errors are o(n/h) and o(n³/h), the cross-bracket vanishes by sum a_i=0, and W² is lower order than L. For nh→λ>0, Bernoulli switch points converge to a Poisson process, yielding joint occupation/inversion-area convergence, zero covariance by bounded limits and dependence from a positive atom. The packaged checker independently counts inversions on 2^n words for n=2..9 and passes 5,560 exact rational assertions; finite tests do not prove limits.

value.rationale: The packet count is a directly specified natural component of the inverse-riffle construction, while inversion count measures its induced order disorder. The exact conditional regression states a distribution-free (across adhesion) prediction of disorder given packet size despite strongly correlated labels. The joint theorem identifies a sharp structural distinction: true dependence and zero correlation at every finite n, a still dependent non-Gaussian telegraph limit under finitely many switches, and asymptotic independence in the many-switch Gaussian limit. These conclusions add an interpretable joint dependence invariant not obtained from the previously known univariate inversion fluctuation theorem; no mixing improvement or new marginal CLT is claimed.
